title: European Commission: Communication on Elections to the European Parliament (2003) (English)
text: On 8 April, the European Commission issued a Communication (COM(2003) 174 final) on measures to be taken by Member States to ensure participation of all citizens of the Union to the 2004 elections to the European Parliament in an enlarged Union. Generally, the Communication stipulates that in accordance with Art.39(1) of the Charter of Fundamental Rights of the European Union, each Union citizen has the right ti vote and to stand as a candidate in the elections to the European Parliament in the Member State in which he or she resides. Furthermore, the Communications honours the commitment made to the ten acceding states by confirming their participation in the elections to a EU Parliament which will seat 732 members for the term 2003 to 2009.
